==== input.vue (6 findings) ====
<template>
    <!-- Tailwind 4.3.4+ names arbitrary breakpoint and container variants -->
    <div class="max-[64rem]:flex @max-[32rem]:hidden min-[48rem]:p-[16px]"></div>
                ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'max-[64rem]:flex' can be written as 'max-lg:flex'
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class '@max-[32rem]:hidden' can be written as '@max-lg:hidden'
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'min-[48rem]:p-[16px]' can be written as 'md:p-4'
    <div class="max-[64rem]:p-4 @min-[48rem]:grid"></div>
                ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'max-[64rem]:p-4' can be written as 'max-lg:p-4'
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class '@min-[48rem]:grid' can be written as '@3xl:grid'
    <!-- the & is kept when a pseudo-element moves into ** (wrong before 4.3.4) -->
    <div class="[&_::before]:block"></div>
                ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class '[&_::before]:block' can be written as '**:[&::before]:block'
    <!-- left alone: no named breakpoint matches, or the variant is named already -->
    <div class="max-[63rem]:flex md:flex hover:hidden"></div>
</template>

=== FIXED (--fix) ===
<template>
    <!-- Tailwind 4.3.4+ names arbitrary breakpoint and container variants -->
    <div class="max-lg:flex @max-lg:hidden md:p-4"></div>
    <div class="max-lg:p-4 @3xl:grid"></div>
    <!-- the & is kept when a pseudo-element moves into ** (wrong before 4.3.4) -->
    <div class="**:[&::before]:block"></div>
    <!-- left alone: no named breakpoint matches, or the variant is named already -->
    <div class="max-[63rem]:flex md:flex hover:hidden"></div>
</template>
